title: Reading practice

format.lessons: one entry per lesson, in course order; lesson matches 'l' in app/words.json (1.1 to 20.2, no 11.2)
format.passages: two per lesson: a dialogue and a short story (kind: 'dialogue' or 'story')
format.title: {zh, py, en}
format.lines: one per sentence or speaking turn: {speaker?, speaker_py?, zh, py, en}; speaker is only on dialogue lines
format.text: all line zh joined, for listening mode (read it aloud with zh-CN speech, text hidden)
format.words: this lesson's own vocab (words.json 'd') that the passage uses, in order of first use
format.questions: {zh, py, en, options}: asked in Chinese, with pinyin and English available; options are in English and the FIRST option is always the right answer, so shuffle before showing (same convention as lessons.json)
format.py: pinyin with dictionary tones, like words.json (no 一/不 tone-change marks), erhua written as -r, words separated by spaces

vocab_rule: Every Chinese character in a lesson's passages, titles and questions comes from that lesson's vocab or an earlier lesson's, plus 你, 中, the numbers 一 to 十 and the cast's names (王小明, 李文, 马克, 安娜). No multi-character vocab item is used before the lesson that teaches it (except 中国, 英国, 哪国人 and 分钟, whose characters are already known). tools/reading_build.py checks this on every build.

lines.zh: 我叫安娜，我不是中国人。

lines.py: Tā ne? Tā xìng Wáng, míngzi shì Xiǎomíng.

lines.py: Tā yě shì Zhōngguó rén.

questions.en: What language do they both speak?

passages.text: 你好！你是老师吗？不是，我们是同学！你好，同学！我叫马克。你叫什么名字？我叫王小明。你是哪国人？我是美国人。你呢？我是中国人。你说汉语吗？我说英语，也说汉语。你说英语还是法语？我只说汉语。好，我们都说汉语！

lines.py: Tā shuō Yīngyǔ, yě shuō Fǎyǔ.

lines.zh: 马克是美国人，小明是中国人，他们都说汉语。
lines.py: Mǎkè shì Měiguó rén, Xiǎomíng shì Zhōngguó rén, tāmen dōu shuō Hànyǔ.
